title: In the living room
about: Things in a living room, like the sofa, the armchair, the curtains and the remote control. What we do there (watch TV, listen to music, read, relax) and useful expressions like switch on the light.

parts.title: Common mistakes
parts.note: Меблі англійською — furniture, і це слово незлічуване: дієслово з ним в однині (the furniture is), без -s і без a. Один предмет меблів — a piece of furniture. Ще кілька помилок, які часто роблять у цьому юніті: listen завжди з to, watch TV — без at, relax — без «себе», а займенник стоїть між дієсловом і on / off: turn it off.

rows: The furniture in our living room is new.
The furniture in our living room are new.
У нашій новій квартирі дуже гарні меблі.
Our new flat has got very nice furniture.
Our new flat has got very nice furnitures.
I often listen to the radio.
Давай просто відпочинемо сьогодні після школи.
Let's just relax after school today.
Let's just relax us after school today.
Switch the light on. / Turn on the light.

items.pattern: in the living room · sit / relax in the living room
items.meaning: the room in a home where people sit, relax and watch TV
items.example: We often play board games in the **living room**.
more: Our **living room** has a big window and a green sofa.
Grandpa is asleep in the **living room**.
items.watchOut: Багато хто називає вітальню «зал», але англійською hall — це передпокій (коридор біля вхідних дверей) або великий зал для концертів. Вітальня — living room; у Британії ще кажуть sitting room або lounge.

items.pattern: a bookshelf · two bookshelves · on the bookshelf
items.meaning: a shelf or a piece of furniture where you keep books
items.example: My comics are on the top **bookshelf**.
more: We need a new **bookshelf** for all these books.
There are two tall **bookshelves** in our classroom.
items.watchOut: Множина — bookshelves (f → ves), як shelf — shelves. Не bookshelfs.

items.pattern: a book · books · read a book
items.meaning: things with pages of words that you read
items.example: There are lots of **books** about animals in my room.
more: Put your **books** in your school bag.
My aunt gives me two **books** every birthday.

items.pattern: the light · switch the light on / off · a light on the ceiling
items.meaning: a thing on the ceiling or wall that lights a room
items.example: The **light** in our kitchen is very bright.
more: Can you switch the **light** off? I want to sleep.
There's a big round **light** in the middle of the ceiling.
items.watchOut: Light — це і саме світло, і світильник: There's a light on the ceiling. Увімкнути світло — switch on the light, з the.

items.pattern: a light switch · press the light switch · next to the door
items.meaning: a small thing on the wall that you press to put the light on or off
items.example: I can't find the **light switch** in the dark.
more: The **light switch** in my bedroom is behind the door.
My little sister can't reach the **light switch** yet.
items.watchOut: Вимикач — light switch або просто switch. Не плутай із розеткою — socket.

items.pattern: a picture · a picture of sb / sth · on the wall
items.meaning: a painting, a drawing or a photo
items.example: There's a **picture** of the sea above our sofa.
more: My brother drew a **picture** of our cat.
Let's put this **picture** on the wall in the hall.

items.pattern: a lamp · a desk lamp · switch on the lamp
items.meaning: a light that you can move, often on a table or on the floor
items.example: I always do my homework with the **lamp** on.
more: There's a tall **lamp** next to the armchair.
This **lamp** needs a new bulb.
items.watchOut: Lamp — світильник, який можна переставити: настільна лампа чи торшер. Сама лампочка — a light bulb або просто a bulb.

items.pattern: a window · open / close the window · look out of the window
items.meaning: a glass part of a wall that lets in light and air
items.example: It's hot in here. Can you open the **window**?
more: Our cat loves sitting by the **window**.
I can see the park from my bedroom **window**.
items.watchOut: Дивитися у вікно (на вулицю) — look out of the window. Look in the window — це зазирати всередину.

items.pattern: curtains (usually plural) · open / close the curtains
items.meaning: long pieces of cloth that cover a window
items.example: I love the blue **curtains** in my bedroom.
more: Mum made these **curtains** herself.
There are yellow **curtains** in the kitchen.
items.watchOut: Штори зазвичай у множині — curtains, бо їх дві половинки: The curtains are new. Жалюзі — blinds.

items.pattern: a TV · on TV · watch TV
items.meaning: a machine with a screen for watching programmes and films
items.example: We've got a big **TV** in the living room.
more: Is there anything good on **TV** tonight?
Our old **TV** doesn't work any more.
items.watchOut: По телевізору — on TV, не in TV і не by TV: What's on TV? Television — те саме слово, тільки довше.

items.pattern: a hi-fi · play music on the hi-fi
items.meaning: a machine with speakers for playing music
items.example: Dad plays his old CDs on the **hi-fi**.
more: Please turn the **hi-fi** down. It's very loud.
Our **hi-fi** has two big speakers.
items.watchOut: Читається «хай-фай» /ˈhaɪ faɪ/, не «хі-фі». Сьогодні частіше кажуть speakers або sound system.

items.pattern: a sofa · sit on the sofa · lie on the sofa
items.meaning: a long soft seat for two or three people
items.example: The dog is sleeping on the **sofa** again!
more: We bought a new green **sofa** for the living room.
Come and sit on the **sofa** with me.
items.watchOut: Диван — sofa (або couch). Divan в англійській рідкісне слово: у Британії так називають особливий тип ліжка. Сидіти на дивані — зазвичай sit on the sofa.

items.pattern: a table · on the table · sit at the table
items.meaning: furniture with a flat top and legs, for eating or putting things on
items.example: We have breakfast at the big **table** in the kitchen.
more: Please put the plates on the **table**.
There's a **table** and four chairs by the window.
items.watchOut: Сидіти за столом — sit at the table, не behind the table. Письмовий стіл для уроків — a desk.

items.pattern: a socket · plug sth into the socket
items.meaning: a place in the wall where you plug in a lamp, a charger, a TV
items.example: Is there a **socket** near the bed? My phone needs charging.
more: There are only two **sockets** in my room.
The TV and the lamp are both plugged into one **socket**.
items.watchOut: Розетка — socket (у Британії), в американській англійській — outlet. Rosette — зовсім інше слово (бант-нагорода).

items.pattern: the remote control · the remote · press a button on the remote
items.meaning: a small thing you hold to change the channel or turn the TV on and off
items.example: The **remote control** was under the sofa.
more: My brother always takes the **remote control** and watches football.
The **remote control** needs new batteries.
items.watchOut: Пульт — remote control або коротко the remote. Не pult і не console (console — це ігрова приставка).

items.pattern: a rug · on the rug
items.meaning: a small carpet that covers only part of the floor
items.example: The cat likes to sleep on the **rug** next to the sofa.
more: We've got a round **rug** in the hall.
I spilt my juice on the white **rug**.
items.watchOut: Rug — невеликий килимок на частині підлоги. Carpet — зазвичай покриття на всю підлогу кімнати.

items.pattern: a phone · on the phone · answer the phone
items.meaning: a thing you use to call people and talk to them
items.example: The **phone** is ringing. Can you answer it?
more: Grandma talks to us on the **phone** every Sunday.
My **phone** is on the coffee table.
items.watchOut: Говорити по телефону — talk on the phone, не by the phone і не in the phone.

items.pattern: an armchair · sit in an armchair
items.meaning: a big soft chair for one person, with parts for your arms
items.example: Grandpa reads the newspaper in his **armchair**.
more: There's a soft **armchair** next to the window.
The cat is asleep in my **armchair** again.
items.watchOut: Крісло — armchair, а chair — це стілець. Про м'яке крісло зазвичай кажуть in an armchair (ти ніби сидиш усередині), а про стілець — on a chair.

items.pattern: a coffee table · on the coffee table
items.meaning: a low table in front of the sofa
items.example: Don't put your feet on the **coffee table**!
more: There's a bowl of fruit on the **coffee table**.
We play cards on the **coffee table** in the evening.
items.watchOut: Журнальний столик — coffee table, не journal table і не magazine table. Ставити на нього можна не лише каву.

items.pattern: a carpet · on the carpet
items.meaning: a thick soft cover for the whole floor of a room
items.example: My bedroom has a soft blue **carpet**.
more: Take your shoes off. We've got a new **carpet**.
The children are sitting on the **carpet** and playing.
items.watchOut: Carpet зазвичай покриває всю підлогу, а rug — невеликий килимок.

items.pattern: a chair · sit on a chair
items.meaning: a seat for one person, with legs and a back
items.example: There are four **chairs** around our kitchen table.
more: Can you bring another **chair** for Grandma?
This **chair** is too high for my little brother.
items.watchOut: Chair — стілець. Крісло з підлокітниками — armchair. Але офісне крісло на коліщатах англійською теж просто chair.

items.pattern: furniture (uncountable) · some furniture · a piece of furniture
items.meaning: things like tables, chairs, sofas and beds
items.example: There isn't much **furniture** in my room: just a bed and a desk.
more: We're buying new **furniture** for the living room.
This old **furniture** is from my grandma's house.
items.watchOut: Меблі в українській — множина, а furniture незлічуване і поводиться як однина: the furniture is, не are; some furniture, не furnitures. Один предмет — a piece of furniture.

items.pattern: watch TV · watch television · watch a film on TV
items.meaning: look at programmes and films on TV
items.example: My sister **watches TV** after school.
more: We **watched TV** together after dinner.
Do you **watch television** at the weekend?
items.watchOut: Дивитися телевізор — зазвичай watch TV, без the і ніколи не watch at TV. Але дивитися на картину — look at a picture.

items.pattern: listen to the radio · listen to sb / sth
items.meaning: hear the news, songs or other programmes on the radio
items.example: Mum **listens to the radio** in the car.
more: Grandpa **listens to the radio** every morning.
Do you ever **listen to the radio**?
items.watchOut: Слухати щось — listen to sth, завжди з to: не listen the radio. І з the: listen to the radio, а watch TV — зазвичай без the.

items.pattern: listen to music · listen to a song
items.meaning: hear songs or music because you enjoy it
items.example: I **listen to music** on the bus to school.
more: My friends and I **listen to music** in my room.
Do you like **listening to music** when you draw?
items.watchOut: Слухати музику — listen to music: з to, без the. Не listen music.

items.pattern: read a book · read (past: read /red/)
items.meaning: look at and understand the words in a book
items.example: I **read a book** in bed every night.
more: My dad **reads a book** on the train.
Last weekend I **read a book** about horses.
items.watchOut: Минулий час read пишеться так само, але читається /red/, як red: Yesterday I read /red/ a book.

items.pattern: relax · just relax · relax at home
items.meaning: rest and do nothing
items.example: On Sunday afternoon we just **relax** at home.
more: After a long day at school, I want to **relax**.
Grandma likes to **relax** in her armchair with a cup of tea.
items.watchOut: Відпочивати — relax, без «себе»: не relax us, не relax me. «Давай відпочинемо» — Let's relax.

items.pattern: It's getting dark · it gets dark · it's getting cold / late
items.meaning: night is coming and there is less light
items.example: **It's getting dark.** Let's go home.
more: **It's getting dark**, so I'm switching on the lamp.
In winter **it gets dark** at four o'clock.
items.watchOut: Темніє — It's getting dark: get + прикметник = ставати. Не It's darking. It's becoming dark звучить книжно, у розмові так рідко кажуть.

items.pattern: close / open the curtains · draw the curtains
items.meaning: pull the curtains across the window, so people can't see in
items.example: Please **close the curtains**. The sun is in my eyes.
more: I always **close the curtains** before I go to bed.
Can you **open the curtains**? It's a lovely day.
items.watchOut: Засунути штори — close the curtains (або draw the curtains). Не make the curtains.

items.pattern: switch the light on / off · switch on / off the light · switch it on
items.meaning: make a light or a machine start / stop working
items.example: **Switch off** the lamp when you leave the room.
more: I **switched on** the TV, but it didn't work.
Don't forget to **switch the lights off**.
items.watchOut: Увімкнути — switch on, не include (це калька з рос. «включить»). З займенником — тільки switch it on, не switch on it.

items.pattern: turn the TV on / off · turn on / off the radio · turn it off
items.meaning: the same as switch on / switch off
items.example: **Turn off** the TV, please. It's time for dinner.
more: Dad **turned on** the radio to hear the news.
The music is too loud. Can you **turn it off**?
items.watchOut: Turn on / off = switch on / off. Можна turn the TV off або turn off the TV, але тільки turn it off — займенник посередині.

items.pattern: pass me sth · pass sth to sb
items.meaning: give something to a person near you, from your hand to their hand
items.example: Can you **pass me** my glasses? They're on the table.
more: Please **pass** this book **to** your sister.
**Pass me** the ball!
items.watchOut: Передай мені — pass me sth, без to: pass me the remote. Або pass the remote to me. Не pass to me the remote.

items.pattern: There's a good programme on (TV) · What's on TV?
items.meaning: something interesting is on TV now or tonight
items.example: Hurry up! **There's a good programme on** about sharks.
more: **There's a good programme on** at eight. Let's watch it.
**There's a good programme on** TV tonight about the Moon.
items.watchOut: Programme — британське написання (американське program). On тут означає «показують, іде»: What's on TV? — Що по телевізору? Передача — programme, не transmission.

warmup.uk: Я дивлюся телевізор щовечора після вечері.
warmup.explain: Дивитися телевізор — watch TV: без at і без the. Look — дивитися на щось, і з ним потрібне at.

warmup.q: Dad ___ the radio in the car.
warmup.explain: Слухати щось — listen to sth, завжди з to. Hear to не кажуть.

warmup.q: ___ the TV, the cartoon is starting!
warmup.explain: Увімкнути — turn on або switch on. Include — «включати до складу», про техніку так не кажуть.

warmup.q: The furniture in our living room ___ old.
warmup.explain: Furniture незлічуване і поводиться як однина: the furniture is.

warmup.q: ___. Can you switch on the lamp?
warmup.explain: Темніє — It's getting dark: get + прикметник означає «ставати».

warmup.uk: Поклади, будь ласка, телефон на журнальний столик.
warmup.q: Put the phone on the ___, please.
warmup.explain: Журнальний столик — coffee table. Journal table і magazine table — кальки.

warmup.uk: Сідай у крісло, бабусю. Воно велике й м'яке.
warmup.q: Sit in the ___, Grandma. It's big and soft.
warmup.explain: Крісло — armchair. Chair — стілець (хоча armchair теж chair), sofa — диван, rug — килимок.
Відпочивати — просто relax, без «себе»: Let's relax.

A.q: Plug the phone charger into the ___ under the desk.
A.explain: Те, куди вставляють вилку, — socket (розетка). Light switch — вимикач, rug — килимок.

A.q: Grandpa is reading in his big soft ___ next to the fire.
A.explain: Велике м'яке крісло — armchair. Carpet — килим, curtains — штори: у них не сидять.

A.q: We've got some new ___: a sofa, two armchairs and a table.
A.explain: Диван, крісла, стіл — це furniture (меблі). Слово незлічуване, тому без -s.

B.q: My brother ___ football on TV every Saturday.
B.explain: Дивитися футбол по телевізору — watch: watches football on TV.

B.q: I'm ___ my favourite song on my headphones.
B.explain: Пісню слухають: listen to a song. Без to не можна.

B.q: After a busy week, we stayed at home and ___.
B.explain: Відпочивали — relaxed, без us. Watched потребує, що саме дивилися.

C.q: Mum, can you ___ the light in the hall? I can't find my shoes.
C.explain: Не видно взуття — треба увімкнути світло: switch on.

C.q: Can you ___ me the remote control? It's next to you.
C.explain: Передати комусь річ — pass sb sth: pass me the remote.

C.q: It's late and ___. Let's put the lights on.
C.explain: Вмикаємо світло, бо темніє — it's getting dark.

example.title: A quiet Sunday at Grandma's
example.uk:
У неділю я була в гостях у бабусі. Її вітальня маленька, але затишна. Ми сиділи на дивані й слухали радіо.

О п'ятій бабуся сказала: «Темніє. Засунь, будь ласка, штори, сонечко». Потім я увімкнула лампу.

Після цього бабуся попросила мене передати їй пульт. По телевізору йшла гарна передача про слонів, тож ми разом дивилися телевізор. Це був чудовий день.
example.en:
On Sunday I visited my grandma. Her [[living room|a1]] is small but cosy. We sat on the [[sofa|a12]] and [[listened to the radio|b2]].

'[[It's getting dark|c1]],' Grandma said at five o'clock. 'Please [[close the curtains|c2]], love.' Then I [[switched on|c3]] the [[lamp|a7]].

After that, Grandma asked me to [[pass|c5]] her the [[remote control|a15]]. [[There was a good programme on|c6]] about elephants, so we [[watched TV|b1]] together. It was a lovely day.
